mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and have class IC/IB antiarrhythmic properties; mefloquine inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing propafenone levels, with additive cardiotoxicity and arrhythmia risk.
action: Avoid combination; if unavoidable, obtain baseline ECG, monitor QTc interval closely, reduce propafenone dose significantly, and consider alternative antimalarial or antiarrhythmic agent.
